title: MSFS Marketplace Update: NEW Drzewiecki Design airports & Tucson City landmarks!
description:
The Microsoft Flight Simulator marketplace just delivered a powerhouse lineup for flight simmers looking to refresh their route network with brand-new handcrafted destinations and visual overhauls! Whether you are spooling up twin turbines for a regional European hop, departing the home of U.S. Airbus manufacturing along the Gulf Coast, or navigating low-altitude desert approaches over Arizona, this week's featured arrivals bring serious visual depth to your simulator.

In this structured marketplace breakdown, we dive deep into today's major developer releases from heavyweights like Drzewiecki Design and IronSim to see which scenery upgrades deserve a spot in your virtual flight logs:

✈️ COMMERCIAL AIRLINE OVERHAULS (DRZEWIECKI DESIGN): We kick things off along the Alabama coastline at Mobile International Airport (KBFM / Mobile Aeroplex at Brookley). Positioned right on Mobile Bay next to the historic Airbus final assembly facility, this scenery features an ultra-detailed passenger terminal interior, animated passengers, custom jetways, crisp apron ground clutter, and full Brookley waterfront modeling. Next, we head across the Atlantic to northwestern Poland for Szczecin-Goleniów Airport (EPSC). Recreated from official architectural visualizations, this package includes the modern terminal layout, custom PAPI systems, accurate lighting, detailed hangars, and full compatibility for AI traffic operations.

🏙️ METROPOLITAN VFR LANDMARKS (IRONSIM): For general aviation and helicopter pilots, we jump over to the Sonoran Desert to explore Tucson City Landmarks. This scenery overhauls the default cityscape with over 150 handcrafted 3D structures, covering iconic downtown highrises, civic centers, luxury hotels, custom night lighting, and the University of Arizona campus with optimized LODs for smooth frame rates.

Which of these new additions are you filing a flight plan for first? Are you flying an A320 or A220 out of Mobile, operating regional routes in Poland, or taking a scenic VFR cruise over Tucson? Let me know in the comments below!

If this structured marketplace breakdown helped you discover your next destination, make sure to hit that like button and subscribe for weekly MSFS realism, scenery, and marketplace updates!
